description: Generalize the proven Postgres review_jobs reliability model into a portable durable-job port and services/worker runtime while preserving Codecamp review behavior; bind handlers to capabilities only after the kernel is accepted.
deviation_notes: Phase 1 is accepted after Tasks 1-5. Task 1's build-context findings were remediated and independently closed; Task 2 established the executable review_jobs baseline; Task 3 fixed the compatibility and intentional-strengthening boundary; and Task 4 added provider-neutral Zod job contracts plus least-privilege enqueue, worker, dead-letter, and replay ports after closing its review findings. Task 5's initial independent review found six High design gaps in attempt expiry, database state checks, active-enqueue snapshots, adoption fencing, legacy preflight, and audit immutability. The remediated design at immutable commit 2c4be6e4 closed all six, and the fresh independent re-review at immutable commit fb8c0d99 passed with no open Critical/High. Task 5 remains design-only: no schema, migration, PostgreSQL adapter, role/trigger, worker loop, live-locking result, or cutover is claimed. With Phase 1 accepted, Tasks 6, 7, and 10 are active; Task 8 remains blocked on the Task 7 PG16 harness, and Task 9 remains blocked on the Task 6 schema fixtures plus Task 7 harness.
